name: opencode-paul
description: PAUL — structured, per-project agent memory for OpenCode. Roadmap/Kanban state the agent can list, order, and keep in sync with Jira & Confluence.
author: Karl-Augustin Jahnel
//devDependencies: The SDK ships with OpenCode, so it stays a peer dependency for consumers. npm never installs a ROOT package's peers, though, so a fresh clone has nothing for the test harness to import — it is duplicated here to make `npm install && npm test` work in a checkout.
